newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa, DAG union resume wage talks.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa, DAG union resume wage talks.

text.p: German airline Lufthansa AG resumed wage talks on Monday with the DAG white collar trade union in what could be the decisive round of negotiations.

Labour experts expect the talks to result in a deal after DAG said two weeks ago it would generally agree to a labour agreement, signed in October, between Lufthansa and the OeTV public services and transport workers union.
DAG, however, still wants to negotiate several additional points with Lufthansa including an improved profit-sharing scheme.
In the Lufthansa-OeTV deal, the union won a wage increase of 1.7 percent and a profit-sharing package -- albeit one too small to suit DAG.
The talks are scheduled to last two days.
